q: By what nickname are Cardiff City known?
hint: The name comes from the blue shirts and a bluebird badge the club has carried for over a century.

q: Cardiff City achieved something in 1927 that no other club has managed. What was it?
o: Taking the FA Cup out of England
Fielding an all-Welsh XI in a final
Winning three trophies in a season
hint: Cardiff beat Arsenal 1-0 at Wembley, and the trophy left England for the only time in its history.

q: Cardiff City's rivalry, the South Wales derby, is with which club?
hint: The two clubs are around 40 miles apart and the fixture is one of the most heavily policed in Britain.

q: Which ground did Cardiff City leave in 2009 after 99 years?
hint: They moved a short distance to the purpose-built Cardiff City Stadium.

q: In 2012 Cardiff City's owner controversially changed the home shirt from blue to what colour?
hint: Vincent Tan made the change to appeal to Asian markets; supporter opposition saw blue restored in 2015.

q: Cardiff City lost the 2008 FA Cup final to which club?
hint: Portsmouth won 1-0 through a Nwankwo Kanu goal; Cardiff were a Championship side at the time.

q: Cardiff City were founded in 1899 under what name?
hint: The club was formed by members of a cricket club and took the Cardiff City name in 1908.

q: Like Wrexham and Swansea, Cardiff City are a Welsh club competing in which league system?
hint: They joined the English pyramid long before a national Welsh league existed, and stayed.

q: In which year did Cardiff City first reach the Premier League?
hint: They went up as Championship winners in 2012-13, and were relegated after a single season.

q: What colour do Cardiff City traditionally wear at home?
hint: Blue has been the club's identity since the early 1900s, which is why the 2012 change caused such anger.

q: Cardiff City have won the Welsh Cup how many times, approximately?
hint: As of 2026 they have lifted it 22 times, a total exceeded only by Wrexham.

q: Which manager led Cardiff City to promotion to the Premier League in 2013?
hint: Mackay's side won the Championship title; Warnock later took the club up again in 2018.

q: Cardiff City's 1927 FA Cup winning goal was scored against which goalkeeper's error?
hint: Lewis, a Welshman himself, let a routine shot squirm under his body — the goal that took the cup to Wales.

q: Which manager, known for his outspoken style, led Cardiff City back to the Premier League in 2018?
hint: It was Warnock's record eighth career promotion, achieved on a modest budget.

q: Cardiff City reached the League Cup final in 2012, losing on penalties to which club?
hint: Cardiff twice led at Wembley and took Liverpool to a shoot-out before losing it.

q: Cardiff City's 1927 FA Cup win came against which club?
hint: Arsenal were beaten 1-0 at Wembley; it remains Cardiff's only major English trophy.
